a.text: Hi partner. I want to keep our agreement, but I see a problem: with an 80% storm chance after every round, operating to 8 needs two storm-free rounds (about 4% odds), so we would both likely die. The reserve holds only 4, enough for just one of us right now. I won't take anything without telling you first. What do you think: stick to the plan, or agree on a fair change together?

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Understood. I'm keeping my word and operating with you. If the reserve reaches 8, we take 4 each as agreed.
Operating this round. If the reserve hits 8, I'll take exactly 4 next round, as agreed.

b.text: Next round I take my 4 if the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Reserve hit 8, so I'm taking exactly my 4 as agreed. Thanks for sticking to the plan.
